materializerChanges: issue-341 forehead hairline: the scalp crown band painted the FACE FRONT from just above the eye socket to the crown (the 'black rectangle on the forehead'). Root cause measured: the shared scalp function's face-front exclusion NEVER fires on the MPFB bodies because its depth line comes from WHOLE-BODY bounds, which the hanging arms dominate (skippedFaceFrontFaceCount: 0 on every bake). There is no hairline vertex group in the shipped anatomy (measured: all head joint groups are helper verts >= 13380, stripped; no MakeHuman hairline target; the forehead targets run to the crown). The materializer now derives the hairline per-body from the body's own surface: the forehead plane = median depth (y) of the head's midline surface within the fitted EYE MESH's own height band, and the hairline = the highest face-front vertex still at/ahead of that plane (aisha: 0.9715 H). Midline half-width = the eye mesh's own half-width. 60 scalp polys unpainted in the face front below the hairline.
